jobs.title: Intern - Associate Business Intelligence Analyst (Grid Resiliency)
jobs.description:
Dominion Energy is committed to providing reliable, affordable, and increasingly clean energy that powers our customers every day. If you want to work for a purpose-driven company that values safety and collaboration, we’re looking for you. You won’t just find a job here; you’ll find your career. Review the position below and apply today.

At this time, Dominion Energy cannot transfer or sponsor a work visa or employment authorization for this position.

Job Summary

This internship will provide direct support to the Electric Distribution Grid Resliency group. This is an exciting time for Dominion as the company is currently engaged in large-scale energy infrastructure construction projects along with multiple in-house projects supporting Dominion's existing power distribution and reliability.

This position provides real-life examples to assist the individual in understanding principles in data analysis, modeling and data science.

Gains skills related to Business Performance, Finance, Systems, Operations, and Engineering solutions. Learns entry level aspects of data governance, cataloging, data acquisition, data quality, data analysis, data interpretation, and interactive data visualizations. This includes support of business metadata, business rules, and influence remediation of data quality defects. Ability to work as part of a cross-functional team to analyze business requirements, assist with the development of model strategies or solutions.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Experience

The position requires a solid understanding related to data driven performance technologies and tools, process, metrics and analytics.

Intern should possess:

- Solid skills commensurate with grade level

- An inquisitive nature and curiosity

- Ability to follow written and verbal procedures

- Strong professional ethics

- Oral and written communication skills, including technical writing

- Planning, organizing, and project management skills

- Effective decision-making skills

- Ability to coordinate multiple tasks simultaneously

- Basic computer skills and proficiency in software programs

- Analytical and abstract thinking skills

- Ability to apply data analytics theories and concepts to industrial problems

Education Requirements

- Student must be enrolled in 4-year degree program. Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems Technology or related field preferred.

- Students must have a graduation date of Spring 2028 or later.

- Must have a 2.5 GPA or greater.

- Must possess a valid driver's license.

Test Description

No Testing Required

Export Control

Certain positions at Dominion Energy may involve access to information and technology subject to export controls under U.S. law.  Compliance with these export controls may result in Dominion Energy limiting its consideration of certain applicants.

What You'll Get

Hourly Rate:

$21.00 - $29.00

The hourly rate listed is the rate we anticipate paying for this position. If a range is listed, the actual hourly rate offered may vary based on factors such as the selected candidate's degree type, academic major, and/or school classification (e.g., sophomore, junior, senior).

At Dominion Energy, we offer excellent plans and programs for employees. Employees are rewarded with a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package which includes: health, dental, and vision benefits with coverage for families and domestic partners, vacation, retirement plans including 401k contributions and matches, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, bonus eligibility, sick leave, and disability insurance.   To learn more about our benefits, click here: Dombenefits.com

Dominion Energy is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin and/or status as a protected veteran or individual with a disability.

You can experience the excitement of our company – it's the difference between taking a job and starting a career.
